description: This file defines a custom error decoder for Feign clients in a Java microservice architecture. It handles decoding HTTP error responses into application-specific exceptions, primarily extracting error details from response bodies and logging errors based on HTTP status codes.

classes.name: CustomFeignErrorDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing Feign's ErrorDecoder interface to handle custom decoding of error responses and mapping them into exceptions for a microservices architecture.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes the Feign response to an appropriate Exception based on HTTP status, extracting detailed error information when available.

methods.name: extractBankingCoreGlobalException
methods.description: Parses the response body to extract a SimpleBankingGlobalException object, handling IO exceptions and ensuring the reader is closed properly.
